title: The Copper Run
pitch: Dez strips copper out of the old signal boxes and owes Victor a cut. He's late. Collect it.

clue_a.label: The boxcar
lines: Spools of copper wire, stacked to the roof. That's not a month's work. That's three.

clue_b.label: The van
lines: A buyer's receipt on the dash. Dez got paid on Tuesday. Cash.
